title: National investment case development for pathogen genomics surveillance
organization: Khoo et al. / The Lancet Microbe
description: Framework article for developing national investment cases for pathogen genomics surveillance, linking public health priorities, system readiness, infrastructure, workforce, and cost-benefit considerations.
keyFeatures: Stepwise framework for national investment case development.
Connects pathogen prioritization with public health actionability and system readiness.
Highlights infrastructure, workforce, accreditation, quality assurance, and bioinformatics needs.
Supports financing discussions with governments, donors, and implementing partners.
practicalUse: Use this framework to structure investment proposals, compare sequencing priorities, estimate resource needs, and justify sustainable financing for pathogen genomics surveillance.
